Bacteroidota.rationale: Large, GC-distinct, 4th most abundant phylum (10.4% of training genomes)

Bacteroidota_A.rationale: GTDB polyphyly split of Bacteroidota; excluded so the Bacteroidota holdout is not undermined by a sister lineage, and evaluated separately

Campylobacterota.rationale: Mid-size bacteria (median 1.68 Mbp), well populated (6.2% of training genomes)

Patescibacteriota.rationale: Reduced genomes (median 0.88 Mbp), the hardest case and the lineage both reviewers singled out; directly comparable to Set C_clean

Halobacteriota.rationale: Largest archaeal phylum in the training set (573 genomes); domain-level generalization

DPANN.rationale: DPANN superphylum (candidate/uncultured archaea, median <1.1 Mbp): extreme taxonomic novelty. Pooled because no single DPANN phylum has enough genomes for an independent evaluation set

seeded: DataLoader worker_init_fn (numpy + random + torch per worker)
residual_nondeterminism: torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=False and torch.use_deterministic_algorithms=False: cuDNN/cuBLAS may pick non-deterministic kernels, so results are not guaranteed bit-identical (cudnn.benchmark=False)
non-deterministic CUDA atomics in some backward kernels
FP16 AMP GradScaler loss-scale trajectory depends on observed overflow timing
DataLoader completion order with num_workers>0 does not affect batch contents (a seeded sampler fixes the permutation) but can affect floating-point reduction order on the host
seeding.note: Given identical data, identical hardware and this seed, runs are statistically reproducible (val metrics within run-to-run noise) but not guaranteed bit-identical. Production V5 was trained with no seed at all, so it is not reproducible even to this degree.

kmer_reselection.interpretation: High Jaccard means the 9-mer set was chosen for near-universal prevalence across core genes and is not driven by the panel lineages, so feature-level leakage is negligible and the holdout retrain is valid with the production feature set. Low Jaccard would mean the holdout retrain should be repeated with the reselected features.

r2_convention: All fields named r2 are the coefficient of determination 1 - SSres/SStot. Fields named r2_pearson are squared Pearson correlation and must not be labelled R2.
primary_estimator: difference-in-differences: (MAE_holdout - MAE_V5) on the held-out phylum minus the same quantity on the in_distribution control. Raw cross-group MAE comparisons are confounded by phylum composition of the control.
